##Test Programs
* alternate-blink.fxc:	blinks USER0 and USER1 LEDs alternately, speed varies with PLL_RANGE selection
* alternate-blink.hx:  assembled version of above
* both-led-on.fxc:  sets both USER0 and USER1 LEDs on
* both-led-on.hex:  assembled version of above
* sola.fxc:  SOLA pitch shifter, -1 to +1 octave on POT0, mix on POT1; generated by gen-sola.js, measured by assembler/sim-test/test-sola.js
* reverse-delay.fxc:  forward/reverse delay after US 9,899,013 (EarthQuaker Devices), runs up to 16K samples on POT0, repeats on POT1, mix on POT2, SW0 held is forward; measured by assembler/sim-test/test-reverse.js
